title: STERNBERG DIFFICULT
description: This dataset contains raw EEG recordings from participants performing a Sternberg working memory task with Russian alphabet letters presented in varying set sizes (3, 6, 9, 12, and 15 letters). Participants' Raven Progressive Standard Matrices scores are also included, allowing investigation of the relationship between working memory load and cognitive ability. The dataset supports research on encoding, retention, and retrieval processes in verbal working memory using EEG.
methods_description: Participants performed a Sternberg task in which sets of Russian consonant letters (3, 6, 9, 12, or 15 items) were presented during an encoding phase (1500 ms), followed by a retention phase (2000 ms, blank screen), and a retrieval phase (1500 ms) during which a probe letter was shown. Participants indicated via button press whether the probe letter had appeared in the encoding set. Each trial was preceded by a 500-1000 ms fixation cross, and 200 trials were completed in total (40 per set-size block). Stimuli were presented and responses recorded using PsychoPy2. EEG triggers marked only the onset of stimulus presentation; retention and retrieval times were computed based on fixed trial timing.
